cohort: The study included sampled women from two hospitals in Ethiopia, one with a maternity waiting home (MWH) and one without, categorized into MWH users, Attat non-MWH users, and Butajira women.
finding: Attat MWH users had less favourable sociodemographic characteristics but better birth outcomes (fewer maternal deaths, stillbirths, and uterine ruptures) compared to Attat non-users and Butajira women.
